description: This Java class implements data access object (DAO) for alarm comments, providing methods to query and manage alarm comment data in a SQL database, including partition management.

classes.name: JpaAlarmCommentDao
classes.description: DAO implementation for alarm comments, handling database operations and partition management.

methods.name: findAlarmComments
methods.description: Retrieves paginated alarm comments for a specific alarm ID.

methods.name: findAlarmCommentById
methods.description: Finds an alarm comment by its UUID.

methods.name: findAlarmCommentByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an alarm comment by its UUID.

methods.name: createPartition
methods.description: Creates a database partition for alarm comments based on creation time.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated alarm comments for a specific tenant.
